system.description:
Archery is the ability to use bows, the most common ranged weapon of the era, as well as crossbows and related weapons. Experienced archers also know how to maintain, repair and in some cases make these weapons. It does not cover spears or other thrown weapons, which require Athletics.

Once you possess Archery, you may opt to bid Mental Traits instead of Physical Traits in the event of ties in ranged combat.
system.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages Vampire, revised as The Long Night)
